text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Portuguese and Spanish state railways to create a joint venture to exploit expected increase in passenger traffic between Portugal and Spain during Lisbon's Expo 98 world fair.
- According to Eurostat, the Algarve will soon no longer count amongst EU's poorest regions, so cutting transfers of funds from Brussels.

- Portugal prepared to lose its European Commissioner as part of reform of Europe's Maastricht Treaty, providing an equitable formula agreed, Secretary of State for European Affairs Francisco Seixas da Costa says.

- Hundreds of farmers demand resignation of Agricultural Minister Fernando Gomes da Silva in protest at government's reluctance to call "state of calamity" due to prolonged drought in southern agricultural regions.
- Government approves proposal to let Post Office set up a bank with Caixa Geral de Depositos a possible partner.
